trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum pops the moment the last one does — for most hunters that is A Long Road, the 100% completion gold. There is no shortcut: one playthrough, about 200 hours, no online trophies.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Story trophy, unmissable. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in the chapter that can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story trophy, unmissable. From Chapter 2 both Jason and Lucia are playable, and most of the open-world list opens up — start scanning vehicles and studying animals as you travel.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story trophy, unmissable. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story trophy, unmissable. By now the stranger strands and side-character missions are showing up across Leonida — do them as they appear so the clean-up is short.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Chapter 5. The story's last trophy. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission, then free roam carries on after the credits for everything that is left.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the checklist at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, 35 tasks. The hardest trophy: it is closer to 60% true completion, covering every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's Target Decks and 70 of the 80 challenges. Everything you did before the credits already counts, and nothing on the list is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, airtime and trick driving. Do them as you travel instead of grinding at the end; ramps and jumps are everywhere once you start looking for them.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play one round of every activity the game offers — a race, a fishing challenge, an arcade game, bowling, a shooting range, a drone race, a meditation spot, a hunt and a stunt — and it pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has its own pattern — learn the targets, then chase gold with speed and accuracy. Ranges are open from early on, so practise between missions.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location (14 locations). Learn each course's shortcuts and gates; a win at each of the 14 spots is what counts, not repeat wins at one.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but repeat wins on the same track do not — work through 20 distinct races across Leonida.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish with Cal when his challenge appears and out-score him — better bait and a steady reel win it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade machine through to the end of a game — finishing one game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's stranger mission strand across Leonida to its last mission — stranger strands are the side missions marked on the map.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's stranger mission strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's stranger mission strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger strands are the side missions marked on the map — finish any 8 of them. The character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) count toward this too.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's stranger mission strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida (18 spots). THE one trophy that may be missable: do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. After Chapter 1 that spot is gone, and there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. The other spots stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at a rare animal — track it with the hunting tools and take it down. Studying animals through the binoculars (100 of 255 count toward 100%) helps you find it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set counts when every card in it is found. They are part of the 100% checklist through Bret's Target Decks, so collect as you explore.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots around Leonida — it is a photo-and-tag activity, so work through the map region by region.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are split into 8 categories of 10, from Combat to Vehicle, and all are available from the start. 50 total is enough — pick the easiest categories first; the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and hide until the heat dies down — alleys and parking garages work best.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past three shops, keep the wanted level alive between them, and do not get caught — if the heat drops, the chain breaks.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan or drive 100 different vehicle models — scanning 200 of the 277 base models counts toward 100% too, so scan every new vehicle you meet as you travel.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first — a tight spot with several close together — trigger Combat Focus and drop five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. A story moment at the airport — it pops during the story, so just play through; there is no separate trick to it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Face the Rhino tanks during the story. A story moment — the tanks show up in a mission sequence, and the trophy pops when that sequence plays out. Just play through the story.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm — a silent approach, not a smash-and-grab.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are part of the robbery side content and the 100% checklist — plan each one, crack the vault and escape clean five times.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road, grab the cash and lose the cops — a moving target, so pick a quiet stretch of road.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida (52 areas). Visit every named area on the map — the in-game map tracks which ones you have seen, so sweep the regions you have not visited yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang (9 gangs). Find one illegal operation per gang and rob it — each gang's operations sit in its own turf.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A story moment with no confirmed standalone method at launch — it likely pops while you play through the story. Listed as unconfirmed by the launch guides.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. A story moment with no confirmed standalone method at launch — it likely pops during a story sequence in a showroom.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play bowling at that alley and follow through on the game — finish the game you start there.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A story moment tied to Jason and Lucia's partnership — it pops during the story, with no confirmed standalone method at launch.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Tied to the choices you make as the story unfolds — play through the story making choices and it pops. There is no single choice to hunt for.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. A story moment with no confirmed standalone method at launch — it likely pops after a retry or a second attempt during the story.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange event somewhere in the world — no confirmed method at launch. Keep an eye out for odd encounters while exploring Leonida.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. A story moment with no confirmed standalone method at launch — try it from a slow-moving car near pedestrians.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through your contacts over time. The total is cumulative, so keep laundering as you rob.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear — spending is cumulative across every shop, so normal play gets you most of the way there.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties (8). Buy every garage on the market — they also store the vehicles you register for the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive vehicles to the app and register them — any 10 count, and garages you own make storage easy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
